objective: Fully implement safe BUKLOD Main render incident diagnostics: preserve legacy hash, classify cause, record safe first-party source frame or Hermes bundle offset with crash-time OTA identity, link idempotently to health events, and show role-restricted evidence in BSOC.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production Android 1.3.6 reported RENDER_3E577D35 on 2026-11-18 at 14:05:34 UTC on route scope. Existing health event retained only hash/route, no exact exception, and linked BSOC case had no verified release association. Main source 404c87e55c62a88c95c7389ac8665f237149702a read first. Exact EAS served OTA and user-specific running update remain unverified; no production write authorized. Supabase has no existing project development branches; production DB migration must not be applied directly before the dedicated staging/RC security gate. No staging backend or production OTA was changed by this DEV work. Reconciled on exact latest main ec15ecb4f92b7440fbe579b3f18b274f512d9876 after independent Faith/Word readability release on Nov18; five existing source paths verified byte-identical to original baseline before overlay; no Faith source touched. Actual BUKLOD_MAIN health backend contract accepts events <=86400 seconds and dedupes for 300s; client and forensic attachment spool bounded to <=23h.
chosenApproach: Reuse original health event RPC without changing its signature; attach a second strictly authenticated, first-write-wins forensic record with only allowlisted codes, source path/line or compiled bundle coordinates and running Expo OTA identity. Retain offline dedupe/retry semantics, never send raw stack/message. RLS-controlled BSOC case view joins by health_event_id. Migration is additive and must be staged/verified before clients are published. Use free ephemeral PG17 CI for migration execution and adversarial RLS/RPC testing, avoiding a paid Supabase development branch; export Android Hermes JS read-only via existing preview credentials. Partition server dedupe correlation by exact OTA ID and safe route hash. Serialize offline queue storage to prevent lost concurrent error reports.
selectionRationale: Detect probable cause locally with zero new native modules; record the exact current EAS updateId alongside a safe numeric compiled frame. Only private matching release maps can recover minified source lines. Avoid guessing from a hash or transmitting raw exception stacks or user content.
alternativeApproaches: Send raw JS stack and message to telemetry: rejected; may expose user/session/private content.
Add Sentry with unconfigured DSN/source-map secrets as release prerequisite: rejected; unsafe/inoperative without exact project mapping.
Override existing health RPC fields with OTA strings: rejected; would break existing semantics/recovery and dedupe.
Add new additive per-health-event forensic RPC/table with RLS: selected.
preserveBehaviors: Old RENDER_ hash, main health RPC signature, error fallback, idempotent offline retry and support thread remain intact.
No change to active navigation, login/auth, Season2 embargo, ads consent/fill, backend RLS of existing tables, media or financial logic.
Only sanitized fixed taxonomy, validated source path/coordinates and Expo runtime/channel/update ID are retained; no raw messages/stacks or secret data.
Older clients and legacy incidents continue to work; BSOC detail degrades gracefully if additive backend table is missing.
acceptanceChecks: Node privacy tests reject message/stack exfiltration, source path traversal and misclassification; Hermes bundle frame parser retains numeric coordinates only.
Client event can upload through standard health queue and then attach forensic evidence to exact returned eventId, dedupe/retry without a second record.
Backend table owner-bound RLS and strict authenticated RPC validated on staging database; unauthorized user cannot attach another user's event.
Exact user-running OTA captured from expo-updates native, web fallback null, platform/runtime unchanged.
BSOC displays case-specific cause, source frame/bundle position, OTA ID without misleading root cause claims; cross-user results remain RLS guarded.
All changed-source TypeScript, protected security, AdMob, navigation, compact-layout and bundle/Expo compatibility CI gates pass.
No automatic Season2 or production OTA. Staging DB security smoke + compatible Android RC required before release.
Ephemeral PostgreSQL 17 successfully executes migration and tests role isolation, SQL injection/path validation, replay immutability and foreign-user denial; no production schema changes.
Exact-branch Expo Android/Hermes JS export with existing preview credentials passes without signed APK, OTA or exposing private keys.
Concurrent queued reports cannot be overwritten by in-flight flush; auth switch blocks cross-account upload; 23h retention matches backend's 24h accepted window.
